notes.title: Blaston Patch: Italian & Traditional Chinese localization added!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42227498/565e6d8106bf0a76a2cdd081b6ebd827b6f55294.png[/img]

Blaston is now available on Pico! With the release, we've also updated Blaston on Steam to accomodate it with the changelist found below.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Game Updates[/h3]
[list][*] Added Traditional Chinese and Italian as supported languages.[/list]
[h3]Localization Updates[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed weapon names in loadouts only appearing as rectangles for Korean.
[/list]

Please make sure to update the game when it's started to ensure that you can properly play the Blaston Spectator.

Thank you for your continous support, and we hope you look forward to competing in Season 2 of the Blaston VR Master League!

Sign-ups for Season 2 are currently live, so if you haven't already, make an account on their page and [b][url=https://vrmasterleague.com/Blaston/Register]register here![/url][/b]

- The Blaston Team

notes.title: The Blaston: Free To Play Update is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=XpMd7DqeWzQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Blaston is now a Free-To-Play game![/b] Welcome to the Free-To-Play Update, we have a lot of things that we included in the game which brings the version number to 2.0! This also includes an update to the Blaston Spectator which we've updated with the highlights and list below:

[h2]New Features in the Blaston Spectator:
[/h2]The free to use [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952470/Blaston_Spectator/]Blaston Spectator[/url] has now been updated to 2.0 with a few new additions to optimize use for continued tournament use. We’ve tweaked the in-game UI, added localization to the client, a camera speed option along with a freecam mode. To fully capture some cinematic shots you can now also toggle the UI in-game with the “U” button.

[h3]Blaston Spectator:[/h3]
[list][*] Added localization support.
[*] Added localization option in settings.
[*] Added a camera speed option in settings.
[*] Added a freecam mode option in settings.
[*] Added a UI toggle accessed with “U”.
[*] Optimized In-Game UI.[/list]

Thank you for supporting Blaston to allow us to get to this point!

Keep in mind that if you’d like to suggest something for the game, we have[url=https://resolutiongames.canny.io/blaston] the Blaston suggestion board[/url] specifically for this! While we can’t promise any changes, posting here helps us understand what the community would like to see in Blaston.

Of course, if you’d like to meet and discuss the game with us and others, then you can also join the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Blaston/]Blaston Reddit[/url] and the [url=https://discord.gg/Blaston]Blaston Discord[/url]!

To keep yourself updated on the game, we suggest you also follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/BlastonGame]Twitter[/url] & [url=https://www.facebook.com/BlastonGame/]Facebook[/url]!

If you're interested in competing in Blaston you can follow our official partner VRML on [url=https://twitter.com/Blaston_VRML]Twitter[/url] & [url=https://www.twitch.tv/blaston_vrml]Twitch[/url].

- The Blaston Team

notes.title: The Blaston Glow Up Update is now live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42227498/5989afb2736b483131d433fc324d7b7523d5d0ff.png[/img]

With the main game updating to version 1.18 (the Blaston Glow Up Update), so has the Blaston Spectator. The update includes the following

[list]
[*] Updated avatar portraits to support new avatars.
[*] Camera support for the Greatstone Valley (Classic) stage.
[*] Updated attachment icons to support weapons with added attachments.
[/list]

Please make sure to update the application as you will only be able to watch matches on the same version.

notes.title: The Blaston Spectator is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38887956/ed5c0f751168d73170d28cdb2812f306d97cf31e.png[/img]

[b]Starting today you can now use the Blaston Spectator for free on Steam to watch Blaston matches on your PC![/b]

With the Blaston Spectator you can watch Friendly Lobbies and Knockout Tournaments in the game by using the codes created within the game. We've had this application in closed testing and for competitions and tournaments, but now everyone will be able to use this to view and showcase the game!

If you've watched Blaston tournaments or streams in the past, you have most likely seen a previous itteration of this spectator, but with the release we've done some significant improvements to it.

[h3]Changelog from Closed Test to Release:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Added a Main Menu
[*] Added Resolution Settings
[*] Added Audio Settings:[/b] You can now adjust the volume of the game, sound effects as well as enable voice chat for the matches.
[*] Knockout Tournament tournament queue now has a new view with animations for when match is starting!
[*] The gameplay screen now has a complete new match UI where we've added the names of the weapons along with any equipped attachments
[*] Ping indicators are now visible for the ones spectating matches.
[*] Adjusted camera angles for regular duels.
[*] Adjusted camera angles for Quick Draw & Street Brawl matches.
[*] New countdown graphics.
[*] Several bugs have been fixed.[/list]
While anyone can use it the main purpose of the Blaston Spectator is for content creators and tournament organizers to be able to view matches in a much easier way. Besides watching the public queue that is sometimes live on the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/blastonofficial]Official Blaston Twitch Channel[/url], you will also be able to see this being used in the upcoming Season 1 of the VR Master League. 

[url=https://vrmasterleague.com/Blaston]Sign-ups for VRML Season 1 are now open[/url], so don't forget to register before they close!
